hard_seltzer_ingredients.heading:
Simple
ingredients
hard_seltzer_ingredients.intro: Sparklys is authentic. Sparklys was developed by Hard Seltzer lovers and masterful neo-alchemists — for ourselves and for you! Our production process and ingredients are natural.

1.text: A fermented alcohol base made from natural ingredients.

2.text: Carbonated water from the beautiful Rhine Valley.

3.text: A touch of delicious natural flavor.

hard_seltzer_awards.heading:
The best
Hard Seltzer in the world
hard_seltzer_awards.intro: Well, at least according to a well-known spirits magazine (The Spirits Business). We are not quite sure what to do with that, but thought we should let you know. PS: In the wonderful world of ratings, “Master” really is the new “Gold” — who knew? So yes, we received the “Super Good” distinction twice and “Very Good” once.

1.alt: Taste Master award for Sparklys Hard Seltzer Holunder

2.alt: Master award for Sparklys Hard Seltzer Holunder

3.alt: Gold award for Sparklys Hard Seltzer Maracuja

soda_ingredients.heading:
Made with carefully
selected ingredients
soda_ingredients.intro: Developed for refreshment and lightness — with plant-based fiber and natural extracts.
soda_ingredients.footnote: *Folic acid contributes to normal psychological function and normal immune-system function. A varied, balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle are important.

1.title: Tapioca & Jerusalem artichoke
1.text: A source of plant-based fiber for smart refreshment.

2.title: Folic acid (vitamin B9)
2.text: Supports your well-being and immune system.*

3.title: Yuzu or blueberry
3.text: Unique, vibrant flavors from natural sources.

4.title: Apple juice concentrate
4.text: Adds a delicate, natural fruit note — without too much sugar.

5.title: Green tea extract
5.text: A natural source of caffeine that helps keep you focused.

6.title: Swiss spring water
6.text: Pure Alpine spring water from the Säntis region.

soda_three_reasons.heading:
Simple
reasons
soda_three_reasons.intro: Developed to combine taste and function while doing something good for your body.
soda_three_reasons.footnote: *Folic acid contributes to normal psychological function and normal immune-system function. A varied, balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle are important.

1.title:
Low in sugar &
calories
1.text: Only 1.4 g of sugar from fruit juice and 12 kcal per 100 ml. No added sugar and no artificial sweeteners.

2.title:
With plant-based
fiber
2.text: With plant-based fiber — plus folic acid (vitamin B9), which supports your well-being and immune system.*

3.title: Naturally invigorating
3.text: Contains natural caffeine from green tea for a gentle energy boost without the crash.

soda.heading:
Your body’s
favorite Soda
soda.text: Like your favorite soda – only smarter. With plant-based fiber and folic acid to support your well-being and immune system*. Trust your gut feeling!

seltzer.heading:
Original
Zeitgeist
seltzer.text: A drink that stays light – even when things get loud. Barely any sugar, a clear taste, and 5% alcohol that feels just right. Sparklys Hard Seltzer makes every round more refreshing.
